headline.title: 科学家可能找到聚变能源捷径
headline.summary: 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室提出一种更高效的聚变路径：先加热等离子体，再提高其密度，与传统方法相反。计算表明，未来反应堆有望以更少能量实现自持聚变，同时避免使点火更难的隐藏问题。
headline.title_en: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
headline.summary_en: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory may have found a dramatically more efficient route to fusion energy by reversing the traditional approach: heating plasma first, then increasing its density. Their calculations suggest future reactors could reach self-sustaining fusion with far less energy while avoiding hidden problems that make ignition harder. The team says this counterintuitive sequence could help future reactors achieve ignition more easily.
headline.original_title: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
headline.reason: 该发现若成立，可能大幅降低聚变能实现难度，是今日评分最高的科学突破，具有长期能源影响。
headline.reason_en: If validated, this could significantly lower the barrier to fusion energy. It is today's highest-scored science breakthrough with long-term energy implications.
